_about: Jobs for tools/pack_fetch.tscn. 'downloads' are packs with a plain zip link on a web page (the zip is saved as assets/cc0/_zips/<id>.zip). Packs behind a click-through page (itch.io) are downloaded by hand and dropped into assets/cc0/_zips/. Every zip in that folder is unpacked into assets/cc0/packs/<name>/, keeping only 'unpack_extensions' and never a path containing one of 'skip_paths_containing' (lower case). FBX files are kept only outside the Unity folders (the first animation library has its Unreal-named skeleton only as FBX, which Godot 4.6 imports itself).
